Q: Struggling to conceptualize Look At Matrix A:

glm::lookAt expects a target point, not a direction. cameraFront is a direction. So cameraPos + cameraFront gives a point in front of the camera.

(answer by Viktor Sbruev)

Q: How do I use async function as Promise executor in js? A:

Not exactly, it's different if Promise isn't native promise but some other implementation. This happens with Angular and zone.js. In this case it would be Promise.resolve(I_am_async_function()). Either way, promise constructor antipattern should be avoided.

Q: Which API's are best for E-commerce Website? A:

use REST (or GraphQL) over SOAP for most modern e-commerce sites. SOAP is mature and strict, but it’s heavier, slower to iterate, and uncommon for new web apps. REST (or GraphQL) is simpler for clients, widely supported, and fits typical e-commerce traffic patterns.

So the best API is less about SOAP vs REST and more about:

  • payment provider APIs (Stripe/Adyen),

  • shipping APIs (Shippo/EasyPost),

  • tax APIs (TaxJar/Avalara),

  • and your own catalog/checkout API (REST/GraphQL).
